title: Twenty-Three
summary: On Day nine, Maya finally cracks the torch code from Calder Tower.

beats.text: All night the boy sat by the elevator, humming the same six notes.
I spread my city model across the desk. Calder Tower had only ever flashed numbers.
Two long, three short. Twenty-three. Forty-one. Thirty.
"Twenty-three isn't a floor," I whispered. "It's the steps on the skybridge."
Dev checked the plans. "Twenty-three steps, then a door with no handle."
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: A hundred metres of glass, and nowhere to hide.
The elevator dinged. The boy stood inside, hand on the button. "Ready when you are."
Ruth texted: Do not count the steps. Counting is how they find you.
lines: Counting is how they find you.

beats.text: The numbers fell by themselves. Twenty-three. Twenty-two. Twenty-one.
